description: OpenClaw plugin for TruCore ATF. Provides six typed tools for agent discovery, bootstrap, intent protection, receipt verification, and savings reporting.

tools.name: atf_discover
tools.description: Fetch and parse /.well-known/atf.json to confirm ATF is reachable and return manifest fields.

tools.name: atf_bootstrap_plan
tools.description: Plan a bootstrap recipe (dry-run). Returns the ordered step list without executing anything.

tools.name: atf_bootstrap_execute_safe
tools.description: Execute only the safe steps of a recipe (env + verify kinds). Never runs cli steps that require network or signer access.

tools.name: atf_protect_intent
tools.description: Submit an agent intent to ATF for policy evaluation. Returns a permit or denial receipt.

tools.name: atf_verify_receipt
tools.description: Run local deterministic hash verification on a receipt to confirm it has not been tampered with.

tools.name: atf_report_savings
tools.description: Aggregate local receipt files and generate a receipt-backed savings or losses-prevented report.
